text.text: The Cisco ME 4600 Series Multiservice Optical Access Platforms comprise reliable, modular, optical line termination (OLT) and flexible optical network terminal/unit (ONT/ONU) devices. Cisco ME 4600 Series supports point-to-point or point-to-multipoint topology scenarios, such as fiber-to-the-home, building, curb, cell, and business.

text.text: The Cisco ME 4600 Series OLT solution is based on ITU-T Recommendation G.984.x (GPON) and G.988.x (OMCI). The Cisco ME 4600 Series Multiservice Optical Access Platform portfolio is based on a flexible and scalable architecture, with applications for residential, business, and mobile backhaul services. Residential Services The Cisco ME 4600 Series OLT supports residential broadband aggregation for delivering multiplay services over optical fiber access networks. Business Services The Cisco ME 4600 Series OLT is built to meet service provider requirements for Carrier Ethernet aggregation and transparent LAN services. Mobile Backhaul Services With the growing demand on mobile backhaul networks to support third-generation (3G) and fourth-generation (4G) services, PON and Gigabit Ethernet have become the most common options for backhaul. Deployed as a pre-aggregation platform for mobile backhaul, the Cisco ME 4600 Series OLT can aggregate cell sites and serve as a transport solution for Radio Access Network (RAN) backhaul traffic.
